The '''Geonosian Hive Army''' was part of the military forces of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] that consisted of the [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] [[Alien/Legends|aliens]]' [[Warrior caste (Geonosian)/Legends|warrior caste]]. While lacking a formal military, the [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]] were usually sufficient in dealing with both criminal or security issues. Typically, the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] warriors served their [[Geonosian/Legends#Queen Caste|queens]] and took orders from no one else. In battle, these warriors threw themselves at their enemies in whatever numbers available. Their armies lacked any concept of squads, ranks or orders of battle. As a result, an encounter with the Geonosian Hive Army could lead to conflicts with either a handful of regulars, a swarm of elite warriors, or even a combination of the two, however, they did often employ ambush tactics.
